memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: Then the Lord said to Joshua, "Command the priests carrying the ark of the covenant law to come up out of the Jordan." So Joshua commanded the priests, "Come up out of the Jordan." And the priests came up out of the river carrying the ark of the covenant of the Lord. No sooner had they set their feet on the dry ground than the waters of the Jordan returned to their place and ran at flood stage as before. — Josh 4:15-18 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
The moment the priests stepped up onto the bank, the Jordan came rushing back to flood stage, exactly as it had been. This detail matters. The miracle held for precisely as long as it was needed and not a moment longer. God's power was perfectly timed — the waters parted at the priests' first step in, and they returned at the priests' last step out.

There is deep reassurance in this. God's provision lasts exactly as long as we need it. He does not withdraw His help too early, leaving us stranded midstream. The waters stayed back until every last Israelite, and finally the priests themselves, were safely across. God finishes what He starts.

Notice also that the returning flood showed everyone just how great the miracle had been. Seeing the river roaring at full strength again, the people could grasp what God had held back for them. Sometimes we only appreciate the magnitude of God's protection when we see what we were spared from.

The God who provides exactly the grace we need, exactly when we need it, is the same God who meets us in Christ. His mercies are "new every morning" (Lam 3:23), never running out too soon. We can trust Him to hold back the waters until we are safely home, and to give us grace sufficient for each day's crossing.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Have you ever seen how God's help lasted exactly as long as you needed it?
2. Do you trust that God will not withdraw His grace too early?
3. Looking back, can you now see the "flood" you were spared from?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, thank You that Your grace is perfectly timed and never runs out too soon. Help me trust You to carry me all the way across. Amen.
